ai_summary: **Executive Summary**  Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited (APSEZ) has incorporated a new wholly-owned subsidiary, Paradip Mahanadi Terminal Limited, on October 6, 2026. This entity is established to develop and operate two dry bulk berths at Paradip Port, Odisha, signaling APSEZ's continued strategic expansion in port infrastructure. The immediate financial impact is negligible, with the subsidiary incorporated with a modest paid-up capital of Rs. 500,000, and no red flags are apparent in this incorporation notice.
